$comment: Lane models are NOT written in this file. `resolve` tells `oc-harness use` to derive the chains from the live catalogue, inside this profile's retention ceiling, and record which models it chose in the lock file next to opencode.jsonc. Re-resolve with `oc-harness use big-pickle-auto --yes`; run offline against the existing lock with `--offline`. The base model is Big Pickle, so a lane the catalogue cannot fill runs on it rather than failing.
title: Big Pickle, lanes resolved from the live catalogue
notes: Big Pickle as the base model and the last rung of every lane, with the other lanes derived from whatever free models the catalogue lists today. The point is that a withdrawn model stops being a broken chain: the next `use` picks a replacement from the catalogue instead of falling back to one model doing ten jobs. Everything here is may-train, which is why this is a choice you make, not the default.
